ReconRiver data in ClearLedger
==============================

Derived from "ReconRiver Synthetic Reconciliation Scenarios" by heybadrinath,
https://huggingface.co/datasets/heybadrinath/reconriver-synthetic-reconciliation
source revision 2f128f1059b1faee78d73c0ffc0f5e745c075d9b,
licensed CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The data is entirely synthetic: no genuine people, payments, cards or accounts.

Changes made: rows were converted to ClearLedger's CSV format and integer cents,
relabeled to ClearLedger case kinds (MATCHED -> matched, AMOUNT_MISMATCH ->
amount_mismatch, MISSING_BANK_SETTLEMENT -> awaiting_deposit, MISSING_PROCESSOR ->
unexpected_deposit), given scenario ID prefixes (CS:, MX:), and filtered by the
clearledger-curation-v1 rules. A batch is dropped whole when:

  R1_NON_USD              any processor or bank row is not USD
  R2_INVALID_ROW          a row has a bad ID, amount, date or fee, or net != gross - fee
  R3_REPEATED_SOURCE_ID   a source ID occurs more than once
  R4_NO_LABEL             the batch has no settlement ground truth
  R5_OUTCOME_NOT_MODELED  the label is LATE_SETTLEMENT, DUPLICATE_BANK_ENTRY or CURRENCY_MISMATCH
  R6_LABEL_ARITHMETIC     the label's difference is not bank credits minus processor net
  R7_LABEL_WITHOUT_ROWS   a label names a batch with no rows (logged only)

Every dropped row is listed with its rule in each scenario's quarantine.csv, and
manifest.json records source and curated checksums. Regenerate with
`node scripts/reconriver.mjs curate`; never edit the CSV files by hand.
